map.输入整层水汽通量与抬升指数（LI），结合水汽条件与大气稳定度估算降水发生概率和量: Enter the whole-layer water vapour flux and the lifted index (LI), and estimate precipitation probability and magnitude from moisture conditions and atmospheric stability.
map.由历史相似天气的降雨频率估今日降水概率。: Estimate today's precipitation probability from the rain frequency of historically similar weather.
map.数值模式多个成员降水占比作概率。: Take the share of ensemble members reporting rain as the probability.
map.给「30% 降水」通俗解读。: Give a plain-language reading of '30% chance of rain'.
map.：过去 100 个「相似环流+湿度」日中有 70 天下雨 → 降水概率≈70%，: : of the past 100 days with 'similar circulation plus humidity', 70 had rain -> precipitation probability about 70%, so bring an umbrella.
map.：数值模式 20 个成员里 6 个报雨 → 概率 30%，属「可能下但不大」，按: : 6 of 20 numerical model members report rain -> probability 30%, meaning 'it may rain but not heavily', so decide by how important the activity is.
map.降水概率 30% 是什么意思？: What does a 30% chance of rain mean?
map.指预报区域内任一地点下雨的可能性 30%，不是「下 30% 时间/面积」。: It means a 30% chance of rain at any given point in the forecast area, not 'raining 30% of the time or area'.
map.不能简单相加；不同来源概率需看同一口径（地点/时段）。: They cannot simply be added; probabilities from different sources must share the same basis (location / time window).
